method.sourceValidation: The standard Node 22.22.3 producer API validateTrack({rootDirectory:"./patternly-content",trackId:"object-oriented-design-interview"}) was run read-only on the bound source; it returned 1413 questions at the current catalog version. No migration/build was run and no source was changed.
method.hashRule: Per-file SHA256 binds raw source bytes. Per-question SHA256 is SHA256(canonicalJson(question)); independently recomputed here with recursively sorted keys and compact UTF-8 JSON and matched the prior ledger for all 324 objects.
method.reuseRule: For prior CONFIRMED items, reuse the exact prior case-specific review only where whole-question and raw-source hashes match. For all 50 CONTRACT_GAP items and both NOT_REPRODUCED controls, inspect the current whole object including prompt, constraints, every option, answer/scoring, Reason, all Details fields, every feedback message, and sourceRefs.
method.classificationLimit: CONFIRMED/CONTRACT_GAP/NOT_REPRODUCED are source-observation dispositions, not final package acceptance. A gap means the current case/options/explanation do not establish a case-specific learning decision; it does not by itself prove the keyed option is false.

keyedDecisionTemplates: Confine or replace shared mutable state before adding synchronization to every caller.

unitSummaries.objective: Locks, immutability, actors, queues, and ownership transfer
keyedDecisionTemplates: Choose one synchronization owner or immutable transfer model so a compound invariant has one coordination point.

unitSummaries.objective: Atomicity, races, visibility, and happens-before reasoning
keyedDecisionTemplates: Reason about visibility and the entire read-modify-write operation, not just whether each method is individually synchronized.

unitSummaries.objective: Deadlocks, lock ordering, starvation, and livelock
keyedDecisionTemplates: Define a consistent lock order or remove nested ownership so progress does not depend on timing.
Treat compound operations as a separate atomicity decision even when the collection methods are thread-safe.

unitSummaries.objective: Async operations, cancellation, timeouts, and completion
keyedDecisionTemplates: Propagate cancellation, timeout, and completion ownership through the workflow instead of abandoning the resource.

unitSummaries.objective: Resource ownership, RAII, disposal, and cleanup
keyedDecisionTemplates: Acquire and release resources through a scope that survives errors and makes ownership visible.

unitSummaries.objective: Exception safety, failure propagation, and partial effects
keyedDecisionTemplates: Specify which effects commit, roll back, or remain retryable when a collaborator fails midway.
Make a retry key or idempotent state transition part of the object boundary before adding automatic retries.

unitSummaries.objective: Test seams, dependency boundaries, mocks, stubs, and fakes
keyedDecisionTemplates: Inject clocks, I/O, randomness, and collaborators through narrow seams so tests observe behavior deterministically.

unitSummaries.objective: Testable constructors, clocks, randomness, I/O, and collaborators
keyedDecisionTemplates: Keep construction and time/environment acquisition explicit so a unit test can control its inputs.

unitSummaries.objective: Code smells, feature envy, data clumps, and misplaced behavior
keyedDecisionTemplates: Move behavior toward the data and invariant it manipulates, then remove the old forwarding path.
Refactor in small behavior-preserving steps with tests that protect the contract before changing structure.

unitSummaries.objective: Public API compatibility, versioning, and deprecation
keyedDecisionTemplates: Evolve a public contract with compatibility and deprecation rules rather than silently changing existing callers.

unitSummaries.objective: Observability, diagnostics, and explainable object behavior
keyedDecisionTemplates: Make important state changes and failures diagnosable without exposing mutable internals as a logging shortcut.

unitSummaries.objective: Abstraction cost, performance, memory, and allocation trade-offs
keyedDecisionTemplates: Use workload evidence to justify indirection, allocation, and memory trade-offs after correctness is secured.

unitSummaries.objective: Overengineering, pattern misuse, YAGNI, and simplicity
keyedDecisionTemplates: Add an abstraction only when a real second variability, ownership, or substitution boundary exists.

unitSummaries.objective: Design-review communication, alternatives, and iterative refinement
keyedDecisionTemplates: Explain the selected boundary, rejected alternative, and change pressure so another engineer can reevaluate the decision.
